        new(new global::SourceGen.Ioc.ServiceIdentifier(serviceType, key), resolver);

    private static __IocResolver __EnumerableResolver<T>(object key, global::System.Func<global::TestNamespace.TestContainer, object> resolver)
    {
        var serviceKey = key == global::SourceGen.Ioc.ServiceIdentifier.NonKeyed ? null : key;
        return new(new global::SourceGen.Ioc.ServiceIdentifier(typeof(global::System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<T>), key), new global::SourceGen.Ioc.IocCollectionResolver<global::TestNamespace.TestContainer>(resolver, c => c.__MergeFallbackServices((T[])resolver(c), serviceKey)).Resolve);
    }

    private static __IocResolver[] __CollectionResolvers<T>(global::System.Func<global::TestNamespace.TestContainer, object> resolver) =>
    [
        __EnumerableResolver<T>(global::SourceGen.Ioc.ServiceIdentifier.NonKeyed, resolver),
        __Resolver(typeof(global::System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyCollection<T>), resolver),
        __Resolver(typeof(global::System.Collections.Generic.ICollection<T>), resolver),
        __Resolver(typeof(global::System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<T>), resolver),
        __Resolver(typeof(global::System.Collections.Generic.IList<T>), resolver),
        __Resolver(typeof(T[]), resolver),
    ];

    #endregion

    #region IServiceProviderFactory<IServiceCollection>

    private object? _ownedFallbackProvider;

    /// <summary>
    /// Builds a <see cref="TestContainer"/> from an IServiceCollection, which becomes its fallback service provider.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ServiceProviderFactory : global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceProviderFactory<global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection>
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a new container builder (returns the same IServiceCollection).
        /// </summary>
        public global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection CreateBuilder(global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection services) => services;

        /// <summary>
        /// Creates the service provider from the built IServiceCollection.
        /// </summary>
        public global::System.IServiceProvider CreateServiceProvider(global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection containerBuilder)
        {
            var fallbackProvider = global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceCollectionContainerBuilderExtensions.BuildServiceProvider(containerBuilder);
            return new TestContainer(fallbackProvider) { _ownedFallbackProvider = fallbackProvider };
        }
    }

    #endregion

    #region Disposal

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if(global::System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) != 0) return;

        if(!_isRootScope)
        {
            DisposeService(global::System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref _fallbackScope, null));
            return;
        }

        DisposeService(_ownedFallbackProvider);
    }

    public async global::System.Threading.Tasks.ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if(global::System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) != 0) return;

        if(!_isRootScope)
        {
            await DisposeServiceAsync(global::System.Threading.Interlocked.Exchange(ref _fallbackScope, null)).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return;
        }

        await DisposeServiceAsync(_ownedFallbackProvider).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    private void ThrowIfDisposed()
    {
        global::System.ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed != 0, GetType());
    }

    private static global::System.Threading.Tasks.ValueTask DisposeServiceAsync(object? service)
    {
        if(service is global::System.IAsyncDisposable asyncDisposable) return asyncDisposable.DisposeAsync();
        if(service is global::System.IDisposable disposable) disposable.Dispose();
        return default;
    }

    private static void DisposeService(object? service)
    {
        if(service is global::System.IDisposable disposable) disposable.Dispose();
        else if(service is global::System.IAsyncDisposable) throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException($"'{service.GetType()}' type only implements IAsyncDisposable. Use DisposeAsync to dispose the container.");
    }

    #endregion
}
